items.title: Crows Remember Human Faces for Years #Shorts
items.description: Studies show crows can recognise individual human faces and even warn other crows about people who threatened them. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
items.caption: Be nice to crows. They remember. 🐦‍⬛ Would you trust one? Tell us below.

items.title: Open Any Stuck Jar Lid in 10 Seconds #Shorts
items.description: Heat expands the metal lid slightly, and a gentle tap breaks the vacuum seal. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
items.caption: Save this for the next stubborn jar. 🫆 Does it work for you? Comment below.

items.title: The Lily Pad Puzzle Most People Get Wrong #Shorts
items.description: Lily pads double every day and cover a lake in 48 days. On which day is it half covered? Day 47, not 24. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
items.caption: Did you say 24? 🪷 Be honest. Comment your first answer.

items.title: The Spotlight Effect: Nobody Notices You as Much as You Think #Shorts
items.description: In a famous study, students wearing an embarrassing T-shirt thought about half the room would notice. Far fewer did. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
items.caption: Everyone is too busy worrying about themselves. 🔦 Does this help you? Comment below.

items.title: On Venus a Day Is Longer Than a Year #Shorts
items.description: Venus spins so slowly that one day there lasts about 243 Earth days, while it circles the Sun in about 225. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
items.caption: Imagine a day that never ends. 🪐 Would you live on Venus? Comment below.

items.title: Why Your Voice Sounds Different on Recordings #Shorts
items.description: You hear your own voice through air and through the bones of your skull. Recordings capture only the air part. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
items.caption: Everyone hates hearing their own voice. 🎙️ Do you? Comment below.
